long_description:
✨ Get ready to light up the night! Join us for a spectacular Diwali Bollywood Night in Atlanta featuring the electrifying DJ Sajan Vadali. It's time to celebrate the Festival of Lights in style at Urban Puff Lounge & Bar! 

Mark your calendars for November 7, 2026, at 9:00 PM 🗓️⏰ located at 562 Wylie Rd SE Ste 3, Marietta, GA 30067, United States 🌍. This enchanting evening promises not only great music but a vibrant atmosphere filled with the warmth of community, delicious food, and delightful drinks. 

Dance the night away to the beats of DJ Sajan Vadali, known for sharing the stage with stars like Arjun Rampal and Baadshah. Immerse yourself in the festive spirit as we come together to celebrate our rich culture and traditions. 

Don’t miss out on this unforgettable experience! Grab your tickets on AllEvents today and be part of a night that you’ll cherish forever. See you there! 💃🕺
